query: Projete uma API de pagamentos idempotente para 50k TPS com consistência eventual, sagas compensatórias, particionamento por tenant e estratégia de deduplicação em janela de 24h. Detalhe contratos, estados e falhas parciais.
Design a globally distributed configuration service with watch semantics, linearizable writes per namespace, and partition tolerance. Compare etcd, ZooKeeper, and a custom gossip-based approach.
Analise um bug intermitente de double-spend em wallet com threads Go e Redis Lua: formule hipóteses, invariantes monetários e um plano de reprodução com race detector e model checking simplificado.
Explain how to implement a fair distributed lock with fencing tokens under Redis failover. What breaks without fencing and how would you test it under chaos engineering?
Modele ameaças STRIDE para um pipeline CI/CD com runners auto-hospedados, secrets em vault e deploy GitOps. Priorize controles e detecte vetores de supply-chain.
A JWT-based microservice mesh shows token replay across regions. Propose a zero-trust remediation with rotation, binding claims, and break-glass access without stopping traffic.
Especifique invariantes e uma prova de segurança para algoritmo de consenso Raft simplificado (eleição + log replication). Onde falha sob particionamento assimétrico?
Given a concurrent skip list, define linearizability vs serializability for mixed read/write workloads and outline a litmus-test suite to catch anomalies.
Otimize consulta analítica em 2B linhas (star schema) com latência P95 < 3s: discuta pruning, sort keys, materialized views, colocation e custo de reprocessamento.
Profile shows 78% CPU in JSON serialization on a hot RPC path. Compare Protobuf, FlatBuffers, and hand-rolled zero-copy framing with migration risks.
Um monólito Django de 400k LOC precisa extrair domínio de billing sem big-bang. Proponha strangler fig, boundaries, contratos anti-corruption e métricas de corte.
Refactor a 12-year-old Java EE app to hexagonal architecture incrementally. Which seams to cut first and how to keep release cadence weekly?
Compare CQRS + event sourcing vs outbox pattern para integração com ERP legado. Quando event sourcing vira passivo e como versionar eventos?
Design multi-region active-active inventory with CRDTs vs pessimistic locking. Quantify conflict rate and customer-visible anomalies.
Defina SLIs/SLOs para plataforma de inferência LLM (latência, custo, taxa de abstention). Como alertar sem fadiga e acionar rollback automático?
Build an SRE playbook for cascading failure when Kafka lag spikes and consumers autoscale into DB overload. Include backpressure and load shedding.
Especifique API GraphQL federada com autorização field-level, N+1 mitigation, complexity limits e proteção contra queries maliciosas de profundidade exponencial.
Design a versioned public REST API with additive-only evolution, sunset policy, and consumer-driven contract tests across 200 external partners.
Em produção, P99 de API saltou 8x após deploy sem erro 5xx. Trace causas em GC, pool exhaustion, DNS, feature flag e plano de bisseção.
Intermittent memory leak in C++ service: outline valgrind vs ASan vs eBPF heap profiling trade-offs in containers.
Arquitete fila de jobs com prioridade, fairness entre tenants, dead-letter inteligente e replays idempotentes em escala multi-AZ.
Implement exactly-once processing semantics atop at-least-once Kafka consumers. Show idempotent writes and transactional boundaries.
Avalie risco de prompt injection em agente que executa SQL gerado por LLM. Proponha arquitetura com policy engine, allowlists e sandbox de queries.
Prove correctness of a snapshot-isolation MVCC storage engine for one anomaly class (write skew). State assumptions explicitly.
Sharding PostgreSQL por tenant vs por hash de chave: critérios de escolha, rebalancing online e impacto em joins cross-shard.
Migrate synchronous REST choreography to event-driven without losing debugging ergonomics. Compare trace propagation strategies.
Desenhe pipeline CDC Debezium → Flink → data lake com schema evolution Avro/Protobuf e compatibilidade backward/forward.
Como implementar profiling contínuo (eBPF) em Kubernetes sem degradar workloads GPU/LLM? Privacidade e sampling adaptativo.
Rate limiting global vs local for API gateway: token bucket, leaky bucket, and distributed counters with Redis/CRDT trade-offs.
Corrija deadlock entre transações JPA e chamada externa HTTP dentro da mesma thread: padrões reativos e boundaries transacionais.
Design a real-time collaborative editor (OT vs CRDT) for 1M concurrent docs. Conflict resolution and offline sync.
Explique memory model C++11 e como data race em cache lock-free pode passar em testes e falhar em ARM.
Threat model side-channel leaks via timing in cryptographic API wrapper. Mitigations and constant-time design checklist.
Formalize semantics of retry with exponential backoff + jitter para evitar thundering herd; bounds probabilísticos de convergência.
Optimize embedding batch pipeline for RAG: GPU batching, dynamic padding, cache of hot chunks, and tail latency under burst.
Extraia biblioteca compartilhada de 30 microserviços sem criar distributed monolith: versionamento, ownership e release trains.
Design GDPR-compliant right-to-erasure in event-sourced system without breaking audit trail. Crypto-shredding vs tombstone events.
Define error budget policy when cost SLO and latency SLO conflict in LLM router. Multi-objective paging strategy.
Projete webhook delivery com assinatura HMAC, retries exponenciais, circuit breaker por destino e ordenação causal opcional.
Root-cause analysis template for split-brain in Redis Sentinel failover affecting distributed locks and cache coherence.
